### E2E-DOC-01 · A Word file, a text PDF and a text file upload and are analysed, and each pipeline stage shows as it finishes

**Covers:** /contracts · /contracts/:id · `POST /contracts/upload` · `GET /contracts` · `GET /contracts/:id` · `POST /contracts/:id/versions/:versionId/clauses` · `POST /contracts/:id/versions/:versionId/chunk` · agent services extract, detect_binder, classify, review · parse.worker · agent.worker (analysis jobs) · TC-ACC-04, TC-DOC-07, TC-DOC-08, TC-SMK-02, TC-PII-01, TC-WF-12
**Roles:** counsel-a, rep-a, viewer-a · **Needs:** agents service + model key · **Time:** ~25 min

**Preconditions**
- Signed in as counsel-a with the `pnpm dev` terminal visible. `D-MSA.pdf`, `D-NDA.docx`, `qa-services.txt`, `qa-fake.pdf`, `qa-legacy.docx` and `qa-empty.pdf` at hand.
- How the stages show (for this and later journeys). The list re-reads every 5 s while any row is in progress; the contract page re-reads every 4 s.

| `analysisStatus` | What is running | Contracts list chip | Contract page band | Step indicator |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PENDING | waiting for `parse-document`, then reading the file (and OCR) | Queued | Processing starting… | Queue |
| PARSING | text stored; `detect-binder` running | Parsing | Extracting document text… | Parse |
| SPLITTING | a binder being cut into contracts | Splitting | Splitting binder into separate contracts… | Classify |
| CLASSIFYING | `classify-document` running | Classifying | Identifying contract type… | Classify |
| EXTRACTING | the agents service's review (extract, validate, score) | Extracting | Routing to AI agent… | Extract |
| ANALYZING | re-extraction after a retype | Analyzing | AI extracting clauses, key terms & risk… (~30–60 seconds) | Analyze |
| DONE, for a few seconds | results written, clauses being stored | none | none | none |
| INDEXING | `chunk-and-index` running | Indexing | Building search index… | Index |
| DONE | finished | none | none | none |
| FAILED | a step failed, was cancelled or timed out | red **Failed** and **Retry** | red "Analysis failed — <reason>" and **Re-analyze** | none |
| DRAFTING | an AI first draft (E2E-REQ-03) | none | indigo "AI is generating a first draft from your request…" | none |

**Steps**

| # | Do | Expect |
|---|----|--------|
| 1 | Contracts → **Upload PDF** (tooltip "Upload an existing signed or draft contract file"). | Modal **Upload Contracts** with a drop zone: "Drag & drop or click to browse", "PDF, DOCX, or TXT · up to 50 MB each · multiple files supported". Footer: "No files selected", **Cancel**, **Upload contract** (disabled). |
| 2 | Drop `D-MSA.pdf`, `D-NDA.docx` and `qa-services.txt` together. | A file list on the left (each with a document icon, its title and an ×) and **Add files** under it. On the right, the active file's name and size in KB, then **Title** (filled from the file name, e.g. "D MSA"), **Contract Type** (OTHER; choices NDA, MSA, SOW, SLA, VENDOR AGREEMENT, EMPLOYMENT, PARTNERSHIP, LICENSE, OTHER), **Counterparty Name** (placeholder "e.g. Acme Corporation") and a box **Link to existing contract** "(optional)" with "Search by contract title…". Footer "3 files queued" and **Upload 3 contracts**. |
| 3 | Set the titles `QA MSA pdf`, `QA NDA docx`, `QA Services txt` (click each file in the list to switch). For `QA MSA pdf` choose Contract Type **MSA** and Counterparty Name `Northwind Traders`. | The fields follow the selected file. |
| 4 | Click **Upload 3 contracts**. | "Uploading…". In the file list each icon turns into a spinner, then a tick, and the selected file reads "Uploaded — AI analysis queued in background". The modal then closes, and three rows are at the top of the list with the chip **Queued**. |
| 5 | Open each new row and click the copy icon beside its title (tooltip "Copy contract ID"). Save the ids as `$C_MSA`, `$C_NDA`, `$C_TXT`. | A toast "Copied", "Contract ID copied to clipboard". |
| 6 | Watch the Contracts list. | Each row's chip moves through **Queued → Parsing → Classifying → Extracting → Indexing**, then disappears, typically within 1–3 minutes (Extracting takes longest). The line under a title reads "<type> · <age>", and the type can change as the classifier decides. |
| 7 | Open `$C_MSA` while it is still in progress. | A blue band with the stage's message and, on the right, the steps "Queue · Parse · Classify · Extract · Analyze · Index" (the current one bold, earlier ones faded). Until the text exists the document area reads "Preparing document…"; then the document appears while the analysis goes on. |
| 8 | `wait_done $C_TXT` | One line every 5 s, e.g. `PENDING`, `PARSING`, `CLASSIFYING`, `EXTRACTING`, `DONE clauses=0`, `INDEXING`, ending `DONE clauses=N`. |
| 9 | Read the `pnpm dev` terminal. | For each upload, in order: `[worker:documents] → start name=parse-document`, `[parse-worker] extracted chars=… htmlLen=…` (for the PDF first `[document] pdfplumber extraction OK … pages=… ocr=no sections=…`), `parse-document done, detect-binder queued`, `[agent-worker] detect-binder result … isBinder=false`, `[agent-worker] classify-document … type=… confidence=…`, `extract-ai queued in agents service`. The agents service then logs `[review] START`, `[review] DONE … type=… title=… risk=…`, `[review] PATCH contract status=200`, `[review] POST clauses status=201 segments=N` and `[review] POST /chunk status=202`. Last come `[worker:documents] → start name=chunk-and-index`, `chunk-and-index done`, and later `✓ job done name=embed-contract`. |
| 10 | When all three are done, open each. | `$C_MSA` (PDF): the document keeps the PDF's headings; the rail has **Table of Contents** with section numbers and "p.N" page chips (click one to scroll to it); the header toggle **Original** is enabled. `$C_NDA` (Word): the Word formatting shows; **Original** is disabled (tooltip "The original file isn’t a PDF, so it can’t be shown here. Download it from Actions."); no Table of Contents. `$C_TXT`: the plain text, **Original** disabled. Each has a type chip, a "Risk N" chip and, where found, value and the governing law after a scales sign. |
| 11 | `cget $C_MSA \| jq '{title,type,counterpartyName,analysisStatus,v:.versions[0]\|{mimeType,fileSize,ext:.metadata.extraction,toc:(.metadata.structure.nav\|length)}}'` and the same for the other two. | `analysisStatus` "DONE". The PDF has `mimeType` "application/pdf", `ext` `{ocrApplied:false, pageCount:N}` and `toc` > 0; the Word file `application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document`; the text file `text/plain`. The title, type and counterparty may differ from what you typed (see Known limits). |
| 12 | Call the agent services directly: `curl -s -X POST $AGENTS/extract -H "x-internal-secret: $INTERNAL_SECRET" -F "file=@D-MSA.pdf" \| jq '{pageCount,ocrApplied,sections:(.structure.nav\|length),chars:(.plainText\|length)}'`; `curl -s -X POST $AGENTS/classify -H "x-internal-secret: $INTERNAL_SECRET" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "$(jq -Rs '{plainText:.}' qa-services.txt)" \| jq`; `curl -s -X POST $AGENTS/detect-binder -H "x-internal-secret: $INTERNAL_SECRET" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "$(jq -Rs '{plainText:.}' qa-services.txt)" \| jq '{isBinder,confidence}'` | `/extract`: the page count, `ocrApplied` false, sections > 0 and the character count. `/classify`: `{"contractType":"MSA","confidence":…,"reason":…}`. `/detect-binder`: `isBinder` false. |

**Also check**
- Refused files: upload `qa-fake.pdf`, `qa-legacy.docx` and `qa-empty.pdf` together with one good file. The good file uploads. Each refused file gets a red icon in the list; click it to read the reason in red: `qa-fake.pdf` "This file type is not accepted here. Allowed: PDF, DOCX, TXT.", `qa-legacy.docx` "Legacy .doc files are not supported. Open the file in Word, save it as .docx, and upload again.", `qa-empty.pdf` "The uploaded file is empty.". The modal should stay open while any file failed. Verify: if it closes, the failures are lost from view; file that. Byte checks in depth: TC-ACC-04; a DOCX that inflates past 100 MB: TC-DOC-08.
- API: `curl -s -X POST $API/contracts/upload -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" -F "title=x"` → `400` `{"detail":"No file uploaded"}`. `up $COUNSEL_A qa-services.txt "QA via API"` prints a new id.
- Roles: admin-a, counsel-a, legalops-a, contracts-a, procurement-a and rep-a see **Upload PDF**. finance-a, approver-a and viewer-a don't; by API `403` "Missing permission: create:contract". rep-a's uploads belong to rep-a and appear in rep-a's own list.
- Audit: `CONTRACT_UPLOADED` with `metadata` `{filename, mimeType, fileSize}`; the contract's **Activity** shows "CONTRACT UPLOADED". Webhook `contract.uploaded` (§8).
- The org's PII mode applies to what the models see (TC-PII-01). An upload whose parse job was lost turns Failed after 30 minutes (TC-WF-12).

**Known limits**
- The title, type and counterparty typed in the upload dialog can be replaced by the first analysis: the classifier sets the type, and the review sets its suggested title and the counterparty it finds. Correct the type afterwards with Retype (E2E-DOC-05).
- A file over 50 MB, or of another type by its name, is silently left out of the list.
- The button says **Upload PDF** but takes Word and text files too. Word and text files have no page numbers, no Table of Contents and no Original view.
- A stage not updated for 5 minutes is marked Failed by the recovery sweep ("Processing timed out — the job may have crashed mid-flight. Click Re-analyze to retry."); a very slow extraction can hit this and still turn Done when its result lands. Rows being drafted (DRAFTING) show no chip in the list.

### E2E-DOC-02 · A scanned PDF is read with OCR, and fails with a clear reason when OCR is missing

**Covers:** /contracts · /contracts/:id · `POST /contracts/upload` · `POST /contracts/:id/analyze` · agent service extract · parse.worker
**Roles:** counsel-a · **Needs:** agents service + model key, and an OCR engine for it · **Time:** ~15 min

**Preconditions**
- `D-SCAN.pdf` (image-only pages).
- The agents service has an OCR engine: `brew install tesseract` (Linux: `apt-get install tesseract-ocr`), or on macOS `apps/agents/.venv/bin/pip install ocrmac`. Restart the agents service afterwards.
- Signed in as counsel-a.

**Steps**

| # | Do | Expect |
|---|----|--------|
| 1 | `curl -s -X POST $AGENTS/extract -H "x-internal-secret: $INTERNAL_SECRET" -F "file=@D-SCAN.pdf" \| jq '{pageCount,ocrApplied,ocrPages,ocrBackend,chars:(.plainText\|length)}'` | `ocrApplied` true, `ocrBackend` "tesseract" (or "ocrmac"), `ocrPages` = `pageCount` (up to 40) and `chars` well above zero. Agents log: `[extract] scanned PDF detected (pages=N, digital_chars=…) — running OCR via tesseract`. |
| 2 | Contracts → **Upload PDF** → `D-SCAN.pdf`, title `QA Scanned agreement` → **Upload contract**. Save the id as `$C_SCAN`. | The row stays **Queued** longer than a text PDF (OCR takes a few seconds a page), then goes through the usual stages to done. |
| 3 | Open `$C_SCAN`. | The header's second row ends with a badge **OCR'd**; its tooltip reads "Text was OCR'd from scan (tesseract, N/N pages). Treat extracted fields with higher review bar." The Styled document shows the recognised text, one paragraph per scanned line, usually without a Table of Contents. **Original** shows the scanned pages. |
| 4 | `cget $C_SCAN \| jq '.versions[0].metadata.extraction'` | `{"ocrApplied":true,"ocrBackend":"tesseract","ocrPages":N,"pageCount":N,"extractedAt":…,"note":"Text came from OCR, not digital extraction — treat confidence accordingly."}`. |
| 5 | Stop the agents service (without it the API falls back to a text reader with no OCR). Upload `D-SCAN.pdf` again as `QA Scan without OCR`. | The row turns red **Failed** with **Retry**. The page shows "Analysis failed — Could not extract text from the document. The file may be a scanned image without OCR support, or the content is empty." with **Re-analyze**. The document area reads **Document extraction failed**, the same reason, "The contract is still uploaded — you can view the original PDF from Actions, or retry analysis." and **Retry analysis**. API log: `[document] pdfplumber unreachable (…), falling back to pdf-parse`. |
| 6 | Start the agents service and click **Retry analysis**. | A full re-process: **Queued**, then the stages, ending analysed with the **OCR'd** badge. |

**Also check**
- With the agents service up but no OCR engine installed, step 5 fails the same way. The agents log reads `[extract] scanned PDF (pages=N) — no OCR backend available (install tesseract-ocr + pytesseract)`.
- Confidence icons on an OCR'd contract's key terms tend to be lower (E2E-DOC-04 explains them).

**Known limits**
- OCR reads at most the first 40 pages.
- The OCR'd text has no page anchors or headings, so citations and the Table of Contents are usually missing.

### E2E-DOC-03 · A binder PDF is detected and split into one contract per agreement, and the split can be adjusted

**Covers:** /contracts · /contracts/:id · `POST /contracts/upload` · `POST /contracts/:id/split` · `GET /contracts/:id/family` · agent service detect_binder · parse.worker (split-binder) · agent.worker (detect-binder) · TC-AI-06, TC-AI-07, TC-KEY-14, TC-ACC-25
**Roles:** counsel-a, viewer-a, admin-b · **Needs:** agents service + model key · **Time:** ~20 min

**Preconditions**
- `D-BINDER.pdf`: two agreements in one PDF, the second starting on a new page with its own title and signature block. `D-MSA.pdf` with at least two pages. `$C_NDA` from E2E-DOC-01.
- Signed in as counsel-a.

**Steps**

| # | Do | Expect |
|---|----|--------|
| 1 | Check the detector first: `curl -s -X POST $AGENTS/extract -H "x-internal-secret: $INTERNAL_SECRET" -F "file=@D-BINDER.pdf" \| jq '{plainText}' > qa-binder-text.json; curl -s -X POST $AGENTS/detect-binder -H "x-internal-secret: $INTERNAL_SECRET" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d @qa-binder-text.json \| jq` | `isBinder` true, `confidence` 0.7 or more, and `documents` with two entries, each with `title`, `docType`, `charStart` and `pageHint` ("~page N"). Below 0.7 the file is analysed as one contract; split it by API as in step 8. |
| 2 | Upload `D-BINDER.pdf` as `QA Binder` (Contracts → **Upload PDF**). Save the id as `$C_BINDER`. | The row goes **Queued → Parsing → Splitting**, then its chip disappears. Two new rows appear, one per agreement, titled after the detected agreements, each **Queued** and then analysed like any upload. API log: `[agent-worker] detect-binder: auto-splitting contractId=… splits=2`, then `split-binder done contractId=… children=…,…`. |
| 3 | Open `$C_BINDER`. | A blue band "Auto-split into 2 contracts — AI split this binder automatically. Each contract is processing independently." with **Adjust splits →**. For the few seconds of splitting, an amber band "Multiple agreements detected — We found 2 separate agreements in this document." with **Review & Split →** may show first. The binder itself is not analysed (rail **Overview**: "No AI summary available."). Rail **History** lists both agreements, each under the label EXHIBIT_ONLY. |
| 4 | `cget $C_BINDER \| jq '.metadata \| {_binderDetected,_suggestedSplits,_autoSplit,_splitInto}'` and `curl -s $API/contracts/$C_BINDER/family -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" \| jq '.children[]\|{id,title,relationshipType,status}'` | `_binderDetected` true, `_suggestedSplits` two `{title,type,pageStart,pageEnd}` entries covering all pages, `_autoSplit` true, `_splitInto` two ids. `family.children` are those two, each `relationshipType` "exhibit_only" and **Draft**. |
| 5 | Open one agreement. | A grey band "Split from binder:" with a link to "QA Binder" and, on the right, "2 total agreements in this binder". Rail **History** shows **Parent** "QA Binder" and `v1` "Split from binder (pages a-b)". It has its own analysis, type and risk. |
| 6 | On `$C_BINDER` click **Adjust splits →**. | Modal **Split into separate contracts**, "Set the page range, title, and type for each agreement": **Agreement 1** and **Agreement 2**, each with a title field (placeholder "Agreement title"), **Page start**, **Page end** and **Type**, filled from the detection. Below: **+ Add another split**, then **Cancel** and **Create 2 contracts**. |
| 7 | Change Agreement 2's title to `QA second agreement (re-split)` and click **Create 2 contracts**. | "Splitting…", then the app opens Contracts. Within a minute the two earlier agreements are replaced: their old ids answer `404`, and `family.children` lists the two new ones, one titled "QA second agreement (re-split)". With **+ Add another split** a third entry appears, and every entry gets **Remove** once there are more than two. |
| 8 | Split an ordinary PDF by API: `C_SPLITME=$(up $COUNSEL_A D-MSA.pdf "QA split me"); wait_done $C_SPLITME; curl -s -X POST $API/contracts/$C_SPLITME/split -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"splits":[{"pageStart":1,"pageEnd":1,"title":"QA part one","type":"MSA"},{"pageStart":2,"pageEnd":99,"title":"QA part two","type":"OTHER"}]}'` | `202` `{"queued":true}`. Two new contracts "QA part one" and "QA part two" appear (their analysis may retitle them). A page end past the last page is cut to the last page. `$C_SPLITME`'s page now shows the "Auto-split into 2 contracts" band, which says "AI split this binder automatically" even for a split you asked for. |
| 9 | Refusals: the same call with one split; the same call on `$C_NDA` (a Word file); then move one child on with `curl -s -X PATCH $API/contracts/<a QA part id> -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"status":"PENDING_REVIEW"}'` and split `$C_SPLITME` again (API, then **Adjust splits →** → **Create 2 contracts**). | One split: `400` `{"detail":"Need at least 2 splits"}`. Word: `422` "Splitting a binder works on PDFs only. Save this document as a PDF and upload it again to split it, or upload each agreement separately.". Moved-on child: `409` "This binder was already split, and one of those contracts has moved on since: "<its title>" (pending review). Re-splitting would replace them. Archive or delete them first, then split again.". In the web app the same text appears in a toast **Could not split this document**, and the modal stays open. |

**Also check**
- viewer-a: the split call → `403` "Missing permission: edit:contract". admin-b → `404` "Contract not found".
- A Word binder is flagged, not split (the amber band carries the PDF-only sentence and no **Review & Split →**), and analysed as one contract (TC-AI-06). A long binder whose second agreement starts on its last page is TC-AI-07. A split asked for by an API key is TC-KEY-14.
- Nobody can write `_splitInto` through `PATCH /contracts/:id` (TC-ACC-25).

**Known limits**
- The binder itself is never analysed; its agreements are.
- Page ranges are estimated in proportion to the text; correct them with **Adjust splits →**. Overlapping ranges are not checked, and an empty range (start after end) is silently skipped.
- Two agreements given the same title share one stored file, and the second overwrites the first (see findings).
- Detection below 0.7 confidence analyses the file as one contract with no band. Only the API can then split it.

### E2E-DOC-04 · The analysis shows every extracted field with its source and confidence, flags low confidence, and rates clauses and risk

**Covers:** /contracts/:id · /contracts · `GET /contracts/:id` · `GET /contracts/:id/clauses` · agent service review · TC-WF-09, TC-WF-11
**Roles:** counsel-a, viewer-a · **Needs:** agents service + model key (for the analysed contracts) · **Time:** ~20 min

**Preconditions**
- `$C_TXT`, `$C_MSA` and `$C_NDA` analysed (E2E-DOC-01). `qa-services.txt` states: parties Demo Org, Inc. ("Customer") and Northwind Traders Ltd ("Provider"); 1 January 2026; USD 48,000 a year; net 30 days; 12 months with automatic renewal unless 60 days' notice; a liability cap; New York law.
- Signed in as counsel-a. The model's wording varies, so check values against the document and don't expect exact sentences.

**Steps**

| # | Do | Expect |
|---|----|--------|
| 1 | Open `$C_TXT`. In the rail click **Clauses → View all**, then **Overview** in the tab bar. | The Overview tab. |
| 2 | Read **AI Analysis**. | Two or three sentences naming Demo Org and Northwind, the fees and the term. The card's button reads **Re-analyze**, with a chevron (E2E-DOC-05). |
| 3 | Read **Key Terms**. | A legend: a grey tick **High**, an amber triangle **Review**, a red cross **Uncertain**. Tiles, each with its icon (tick at 0.9 or more, triangle 0.7–0.89, cross below 0.7): **Parties** "Demo Org, Inc. (Customer) · Northwind Traders Ltd (Provider)", **Effective Date** "Jan 1, 2026", **Value** 48000, **Currency** USD, **Governing Law** "New York", **Payment Terms Days** 30, **Notice Period Days** 60, **Auto Renew** "Yes", and others found (**Liability Cap Amount**, **Termination Rights**, …). |
| 4 | Hover a tile. | A dark box **Source** with the quoted sentence from the document and, when known, its section. The quote reads the same in the Styled document. |
| 5 | Look for a tile with the red cross. | Below its value, an amber line with the model's reason. In the card's heading, **Review N low-confidence field(s)** opens the Extraction Queue filtered to this contract (`/review-queue?contractId=…`, covered in §4). With no field under 0.7, the link is absent. |
| 6 | Read **Contract Details** and the header. | **Counterparty** "Northwind Traders Ltd" (the party that isn't the org), **Effective**, **Expires**, **Value** "USD 48,000", **Jurisdiction** "New York". The header shows "New York" after a scales sign and "USD 48,000", and the Contracts list's **Counterparty** column shows "Northwind Traders Ltd". |
| 7 | Read **Risk Assessment**. | "High Risk", "Medium Risk" or "Low Risk" with a percentage and a coloured bar (red from 67, amber 34–66, green below). Below, **Risk Factors** as bullets and "Extraction confidence: NN%". The header chip "Risk NN" and the rail **Risks** count show the same number. |
| 8 | Read **Clause Flags**. | "N detected" and chips such as **Liability Cap**. The same chips are in the rail section **Clause Flags**. |
| 9 | Open the **Clauses** tab. | A search box "Search clauses…" and chips **All (N)**, **Unfavorable (n)**, **Unusual (n)**, **Favorable**, **Neutral**. One card per clause: a rating badge (**Unfavorable**, **Unusual**, **Favorable** or **Neutral**), a type such as "Payment Terms", "Auto-Renewal", "Limitation of Liability", "Governing Law" or "Termination", the section reference, a plain-English interpretation (or "No interpretation available."), **View verbatim text** (then **Hide verbatim text**) and **Review and suggest changes** (the review drawer, §4). |
| 10 | Click **Unfavorable**, then type `renew` in the search box, then pick a chip with no clauses. | Only unfavorable clauses; then only clauses matching "renew" (in text, interpretation or type); then "No clauses match this filter.". |
| 11 | Click **← Document**. At 1536 px or wider use the header control **Risks: Full**; narrower, Actions → **Risk markers: full** (each click moves to the next level). | **Full — underlines + margin dots**: unfavorable clauses are underlined in red and unusual ones in blue, with dots in the margin. **Summary — margin dots only**: only the dots. **Off — no markers**: none. The choice is remembered. Clicking a marked passage opens the review drawer (§4). |
| 12 | Open `$C_NDA` → Overview, then `$C_MSA` → Overview. | A card **NDA — Specific Terms** with "N fields extracted" (e.g. **Mutual / Bilateral** "Yes", **Return / Destruction of Information**), then **MSA — Specific Terms** (e.g. **Dispute Resolution Mechanism**, **Warranty Period (Days)**), each tile with its icon and a **Source** box on hover. If the model reported extra terms, a card **AI Findings** shows their count; click it to see each label, value and icon. |
| 13 | `cget $C_TXT \| jq '{type,title,counterpartyName,value,currency,jurisdiction,effectiveDate,expiryDate,riskScore,riskFactors,overallConfidence,keyTerms,fieldConfidence,typeFields:.metadata._typeFields,findings:.metadata._aiFindings}'` and `curl -s $API/contracts/$C_TXT/clauses -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" \| jq '.data[]\|{clauseType,riskRating,sectionRef,reviewState}'` | `fieldConfidence.<field>` = `{confidence, quote, section, issue}` (`issue` only below 0.7). `riskScore` is 0–100 and `overallConfidence` 0–1. `_typeFields.<key>` = `{value, confidence, quote, label}`. Clauses carry `riskRating` favorable, unfavorable, neutral or unusual, and `reviewState` "unreviewed". |
| 14 | Contracts → **Filters** → **Clause Flags**. | **Liability Cap** is listed with a count (and any other flag present). Clicking it lists only contracts with that flag (TC-WF-11). |

**Also check**
- Rail **Key Terms** repeats Owner, Counterparty, Effective, Expires, Value and Jurisdiction; rows with no value are hidden.
- Rail **Clauses** previews the first 6 clauses and "+ N more". Bug today: each shows its rating followed by "risk" ("favorable risk"), all in green (see findings).
- viewer-a sees all of this read-only.
- Seeded demo contracts carry hand-written key terms and no confidence, so their tiles have no icons.
- Corrections made in the Extraction Queue update these values (TC-WF-09).

**Known limits**
- A Yes/No field whose answer is No is not shown in **Key Terms**.
- **Contract No.** is never filled, so that row never appears.
- Values show as the model wrote them (for example Value "48000" without separators); the header and Contract Details format the promoted columns.

### E2E-DOC-05 · Analysis can be re-run, fully re-processed, retyped and cancelled, and every failure says why

**Covers:** /contracts · /contracts/:id · `POST /contracts/:id/analyze` · `POST /contracts/:id/retype` · `POST /contracts/:id/cancel-analysis` · agent.worker (classify-document, extract-ai) · parse.worker · TC-WF-04, TC-WF-12
**Roles:** counsel-a, viewer-a, admin-b · **Needs:** agents service + model key; Bull Board (API started with `BULL_BOARD_OPEN=true`) for steps 7–9 · **Time:** ~25 min

**Preconditions**
- `$C_TXT` and `$C_MSA` analysed. Signed in as counsel-a. `$C_TXT` open on its Overview tab (rail **Clauses → View all → Overview**).

**Steps**

| # | Do | Expect |
|---|----|--------|
| 1 | In **AI Analysis** click **Re-analyze**. | The button reads "Analyzing…" and is disabled. The band shows "Identifying contract type…", then "Routing to AI agent…", then "Building search index…", then goes. The summary, key terms and clauses are rewritten; clause review states start again as unreviewed. By API the call answers `{"status":"queued","contractId":…,"analysisStatus":"CLASSIFYING","mode":"smart"}`: the stored text is kept. |
| 2 | Click the chevron beside **Re-analyze** → **Full re-process from file** ("Re-parse PDF, re-classify, re-extract"). | The band "Processing starting…", then every stage from Parse. The rail **Overview** reads "Generating summary…" while the old summary is cleared. By API: `curl -s -X POST "$API/contracts/$C_TXT/analyze?full=true" …` → `"analysisStatus":"PENDING","mode":"full"`. |
| 3 | Click the header's type chip (tooltip "Click to correct the contract type"). Press Esc, then click it again. | A small select with NDA, MSA, SOW, SLA, VENDOR AGREEMENT, EMPLOYMENT, PARTNERSHIP, LICENSE and OTHER. Esc closes it unchanged. |
| 4 | Choose **SOW**. | The chip reads SOW at once. The band "AI extracting clauses, key terms & risk…" "(~30–60 seconds)" with **Analyze** current, then Index, then done. The Overview's type card becomes **SOW — Specific Terms**. `POST /contracts/:id/retype` answered `{"status":"queued","contractId":…,"contractType":"SOW","analysisStatus":"ANALYZING"}`. The audit log has `CONTRACT_UPDATED` with `{"action":"retype","typeFrom":"MSA","typeTo":"SOW"}`. |
| 5 | Retype back to **MSA**. | As in step 4, ending with **MSA — Specific Terms**. |
| 6 | Cancel by API while an analysis runs: click **Re-analyze**, then at once `curl -s -X POST $API/contracts/$C_TXT/cancel-analysis -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A"` | `{"status":"cancelled","contractId":…,"analysisStatus":"FAILED"}`. The page shows the red band "Analysis failed — Analysis cancelled by user." with **Re-analyze**. The Contracts row shows **Failed** and **Retry**. The analysis already running still finishes and can flip the contract back to done (see Known limits). |
| 7 | In Bull Board pause the **documents** queue. Upload `qa-services.txt` as `QA stuck upload` and open it. Wait 3 minutes without reloading. | The band "Processing starting…" gains "Taking too long?", **Cancel** and **Retry**. |
| 8 | Click **Cancel**. | "Analysis failed — Analysis cancelled by user." The document area reads **Document extraction failed** with the same reason and **Retry analysis**. |
| 9 | Resume the **documents** queue in Bull Board. | The queued parse job still runs: the contract moves on (Parsing, Classifying, …) and ends done. Cancelling marks the contract; it does not remove the job. |
| 10 | Make a row that stays Failed: `curl -s -X POST $API/contracts/$C_MSA/cancel-analysis -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A"` (nothing is running, so it stays Failed). In Contracts click that row's **Retry** (tooltip "Re-run analysis"). | Before: the red pill **Failed** and **Retry** on the row. After: a spinner, then **Queued** and the stages, a full re-process that ends done. |
| 11 | Stop the agents service and click **Re-analyze** on `$C_TXT`. | After about 20 s (two tries) the red band reads "Analysis failed — fetch failed" (the reason is the failing step's error). Start the agents service, click **Re-analyze**, and it ends done. |
| 12 | Optional, 10 minutes: pause the **agents** queue, click **Re-analyze**, and leave the page alone. | After 3 minutes, "Taking too long?". Within 5–10 minutes the recovery sweep marks it "Analysis failed — Processing timed out — the job may have crashed mid-flight. Click Re-analyze to retry." API log: `[recovery] reset 1 stuck in-progress contract(s) to FAILED`. Resume the queue. |

**Also check**
- `retype` by API: `{"contractType":""}` → `400` "contractType is required". On a contract with no text (a CSV import such as "QA Import 02") → `422` "No extracted text available.". `{"contractType":"FOO"}` → accepted, and the type becomes FOO (see findings).
- `analyze` on a contract with no version queues an AI first draft instead (`"mode":"draft"`, status DRAFTING, E2E-REQ-03).
- viewer-a sees **Re-analyze**, the chevron, the type chip and the list's **Retry**. Clicking them does nothing and says nothing (the browser refuses; see findings). By API all three routes → `403` "Missing permission: edit:contract". admin-b → `404` "Contract not found".
- Retyping an Approved contract returns it to Draft (TC-WF-04). A lost parse job turns Failed with a retry path (TC-WF-12).

**Known limits**
- **Cancel** (and `cancel-analysis`) only marks the contract Failed; queued or running work continues and can finish afterwards.
- **Re-analyze** re-runs the classifier, which can change a type you set with Retype (see findings).
- A re-analysis replaces the version's clauses, so clause review decisions start over.
- The type chip offers 9 types; DATA_PROCESSING and ORDER_FORM are missing, though the classifier can set them.

- The **Original** view shows only a stored PDF. After an edit the current version is text and the toggle is disabled, though **Download** gives the PDF rendered from it.

### E2E-DOC-08 · A contract's status and details change only along allowed paths, by button and by API

**Covers:** /contracts/:id · /contracts · `POST /contracts` · `PATCH /contracts/:id` · `GET /contracts` · TC-WF-02, TC-WF-04, TC-WF-08, TC-ACC-25
**Roles:** counsel-a, contracts-a, rep-a, viewer-a, admin-b · **Needs:** nothing extra · **Time:** ~15 min

**Preconditions**
- `$C_TXT` (Draft) from E2E-DOC-01. The imported rows: `C_IMP01=$(curl -s "$API/contracts?search=QA%20Import%2001" -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" | jq -r '.data[0].id')` (Executed) and `C_IMP03=…%2003…` the same way (Expired).
- Signed in as counsel-a.

**Steps**

| # | Do | Expect |
|---|----|--------|
| 1 | Create a contract from details alone: `C_BLANK=$(curl -s -X POST $API/contracts -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "{\"title\":\"QA Blank contract\",\"type\":\"NDA\",\"counterpartyName\":\"QA Blank Party\",\"value\":1500,\"currency\":\"USD\",\"expiryDate\":\"$(day +200)T00:00:00.000Z\",\"tags\":[\"qa\"]}" \| jq -r .id)` Open it. | `201`. The page shows **Draft**, NDA, "USD 1,500" and "Expires Mon YYYY", no band (it is analysed as made: `analysisStatus` DONE), and the document area "No content yet." "Upload a PDF or draft from a template.". It is at the top of Contracts. |
| 2 | Change `$C_TXT`'s details by API (the web app has no form for them): `curl -s -X PATCH $API/contracts/$C_TXT -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "{\"title\":\"QA Services (renamed)\",\"value\":50000,\"currency\":\"USD\",\"effectiveDate\":\"2026-02-01T00:00:00.000Z\",\"expiryDate\":\"$(day +200)T00:00:00.000Z\",\"jurisdiction\":\"New York\",\"tags\":[\"qa\",\"services\"]}" \| jq '{title,value,tags}'` Reload the page, then search Contracts for `renamed`. | `200`. The header shows the new title, "USD 50,000" and the expiry; Overview → **Tags** lists "qa" and "services". The search finds it under the new title (the search index was refreshed). **Activity** gains "CONTRACT UPDATED". The tab shows no details; `curl -s $API/contracts/$C_TXT/timeline -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" \| jq '[.data[] \| select(.action=="CONTRACT_UPDATED")][0].metadata'` shows `changes` naming the fields. If `$C_TXT`'s owner isn't you, the owner gets a bell notification "<title> was updated" (at most one an hour; §5). |
| 3 | Merge and delete a metadata key: `PATCH` with `{"metadata":{"qa_note":"hello"}}`, then with `{"metadata":{"qa_note":null}}`; each time `cget $C_TXT \| jq '.metadata \| keys'`. | The first adds `qa_note` beside the analysis keys (`_typeFields`, `_aiFindings`, …); the second removes only `qa_note` (TC-WF-08). |
| 4 | `PATCH $C_TXT` with `{"status":"PENDING_REVIEW"}`, reload. | The pill **In Review**; Contracts shows "In review". The header now has **Start Negotiation** and **Return to Draft** (outlined) next to **Send for Review**. **Activity** gains "CONTRACT STATUS CHANGED"; its `metadata` (from `/timeline`) is `{"from":"DRAFT","to":"PENDING_REVIEW"}`. |
| 5 | Click **Start Negotiation**. Then **Back to Review**. Then **Return to Draft**. | Each shows a spinner, then: the header pill stays **In Review** (under negotiation shares that step) while Contracts says "In negotiation" and the header offers **Back to Review**; then **In Review** again; then **Draft**, with the status buttons gone. |
| 6 | Open `$C_IMP01` (Executed) → **Archive**. Open `$C_IMP03` (Expired) → **Archive**. | Both become **Archived**, with no status buttons left. Their Lifecycle popover reads "This contract is off the active lifecycle. No further automatic transitions." |
| 7 | Refused moves by API, on `$C_BLANK`: `{"status":"EXECUTED"}`; `{"status":"APPROVED"}`; on `$C_IMP01`: `{"status":"DRAFT"}`. | `409` "Cannot transition from DRAFT to EXECUTED". `409` "APPROVED is set by the approval workflow, not by hand. Submit the contract for approval instead." `409` "Cannot transition from ARCHIVED to DRAFT". |
| 8 | More refusals: `{"metadata":{"_x":1}}`; `{"metadata":{"_splitInto":[]}}`; `{"matterId":"<an Org B matter id>"}`; `{"type":"FOO"}`. | `400` 'Metadata keys starting with "_" are set by the server: _x'. `400` 'Metadata key "_splitInto" is set by the binder split only' (TC-ACC-25). `404` "Matter not found". `422` "Request body failed validation". |
| 9 | `PATCH $C_BLANK` with `{"riskScore":90,"summary":"Written by hand"}`, reload. | `200`: the header shows "Risk 90" and the rail **Overview** the new summary. Any editor can overwrite what the analysis wrote (see findings). |

**Also check**
- `POST /contracts` validation, each `422`: no title; `"type":"FOO"`; `"value":-1`; `"currency":"US"`; `"expiryDate":"2027-01-01"` (the date must be a full ISO date-time).
- Roles: contracts-a, legalops-a and procurement-a get the same buttons. rep-a (no `edit:contract`), finance-a, approver-a and viewer-a get none; by API `403` "Missing permission: edit:contract". admin-b → `404` "Contract not found".
- On an Approved contract, changing type, value or currency returns it to Draft; changing one of them together with a status answers `409` "Changing the type, value or currency of an approved contract returns it to DRAFT for approval again. Change the status separately." (TC-WF-04). Approval statuses can't be set by hand anywhere (TC-WF-02).
- `POST /contracts` and `PATCH` fire the webhooks `contract.created` and `contract.updated` (§8).

**Known limits**
- The web app can't change a contract's title, value, currency, dates, counterparty, tags or custom values; use the API (or the Assistant for tags and owner, E2E-DOC-15).
- No button moves Draft to In review: **Send for Review** starts an approval instead (§5). Approved → Out for signature happens only by sending for signature.

- `$C_BLANK` (E2E-DOC-08), `$C_MSA`, `$C_TXT`. `sed 's/60 days/90 days/' qa-services.txt > qa-services-v2.txt`.

| # | Do | Expect |
|---|----|--------|

The blank page shows "Start typing, or press ⌘K to ask AI to draft a clause…". |

| 6 | `curl -s $API/contracts/$C_BLANK/versions -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" \| jq '.data[]\|{versionNumber,mimeType,changeNote,createdByName,s3Key}'` | Newest first: `text/html`, "Edited in-place", `createdByName` "Legal Counsel", `s3Key` null. |
| 7 | After about 10 s, search Contracts for `qazwsx`. | "QA Blank contract" is found, with "Matched in clause body: …". The edit re-indexed the contract (API log `[worker:documents] → start name=refresh-version`). |
| 8 | Open `$C_MSA` and leave it for 30 s. Then **Edit**, change one word inside a clause, wait for "Saved ✓" and click **Done**. | No `html-version` request while you only look. After the edit: **History** gains "Edited in-place"; **Original** becomes disabled with "No original file — this contract was created from text or a template." (the current version is the edited text). The **Clauses** tab still lists the clauses, carried to the new version. |
| 9 | About 15 s later: **Actions** → **Download**; then the v1 download in the Versions tab. | The first is a PDF rendered from the edited text (`GET /download` → `"artifact":"rendered"`); the v1 button still returns the uploaded PDF. |
| 10 | Upload a new version by API (the web app has no button for it): `curl -s -X POST $API/contracts/$C_TXT/versions -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" -F "file=@qa-services-v2.txt" -F "changeNote=QA v2 from the counterparty" \| jq '{versionNumber,mimeType,changeNote}'`, then `wait_done $C_TXT`. | `201` with the next version number. The contract re-runs the whole pipeline (Queued, Parsing, …). **History** shows "QA v2 from the counterparty" and now offers **Negotiate**; **Compare** is enabled. The title and counterparty stay as they were (see Known limits for the type). The key terms now read 90 days' notice. |
| 11 | Save the unchanged document by API: `H=$(cget $C_BLANK \| jq '. as $c \| {htmlContent: ($c.versions[] \| select(.id == $c.currentVersionId) \| .htmlContent)}'); curl -s -w ' %{http_code}\n' -X POST $API/contracts/$C_BLANK/html-version -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "$H"`; then the same with `-d '{"htmlContent":"   "}'`. | Unchanged: `200` with the current version returned, and no new version. Blank: `400` `{"detail":"htmlContent is required"}`. |
| 12 | The clause-store callback, as the agents service calls it after every analysis (agents log `[review] POST clauses status=201 segments=N`). Simulate it on `$C_TXT`: `V=$(cget $C_TXT \| jq -r .currentVersionId); curl -s -X POST $API/contracts/$C_TXT/versions/$V/clauses -H "x-internal-secret: $INTERNAL_SECRET" -H 'x-internal-service: agents' -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"clauseSegments":[{"clauseType":"payment","content":"Customer will pay USD 48,000 per year","sortOrder":0,"riskRating":"neutral","sectionRef":"Section 2","interpretation":"Annual fee, invoiced quarterly."}],"clauseFlags":{"limitationOfLiability":true}}'` Reload the Clauses tab. | `201` `{"stored":1}`. The Clauses tab now lists exactly one clause, "Payment Terms": the call replaces the version's clauses. Click **Re-analyze** (E2E-DOC-05) to restore them. |
| 13 | The index callback, which the agents service calls next (agents log `[review] POST /chunk status=202`): `curl -s -w ' %{http_code}\n' -X POST $API/contracts/$C_TXT/versions/$V/chunk -H "x-internal-secret: $INTERNAL_SECRET"`; then without the header; then with `x-internal-secret: wrong`. | `{"status":"queued"} 202`. The row's chip shows **Indexing** briefly, then the contract is done again. Without or with a wrong secret: `401` `{"detail":"Unauthorized"}` (TC-SEC-06). |

**Also check**
- `POST /contracts/:id/versions` refusals: no file → `400` "No file uploaded"; `qa-fake.pdf` → `415` "This file type is not accepted here. Allowed: PDF, DOCX, TXT."; viewer-a → `403` "Missing permission: edit:contract"; admin-b → `404` "Contract not found". While a Google Docs copy is out, this route and `html-version` answer `409` "<name> is editing this contract in Google Docs (from Version N). Publish that copy back, or discard it, before changing the contract here." (§4).
- Uploading a new version to an Approved contract returns it to Draft, as an edit does (TC-WF-01 P4 shows the edit).
- The clauses route: viewer-a → `403`; an unknown version id → `404` "Version not found". It is meant for the agents service, but any user with `edit:contract` can call it with their own token and replace a version's clauses (see findings).
- Stop the API while editing and type: the indicator reads "Save failed" in red. Start it and type again: it saves.
- Clause tools and search read each contract's current version, not superseded text (TC-WF-14). Smoke check: TC-SMK-03.

**Known limits**
- There is no **Upload new version** button in the web app. Versions come from the editor, the API, the counterparty portal and inbound email (§4), and Google Docs round trips (§4).
- The tooltip promises ⌘E for **Edit**, but the shortcut does nothing (see findings).
- Each pause of 5 s while typing makes a new version.
- The analysis of a later version keeps the title and counterparty, but its classifier step can still change the type (see findings).

### E2E-DOC-10 · Comments are added, replied to, resolved, filtered, edited and deleted

**Covers:** /contracts/:id · `GET /contracts/:id/comments` · `POST /contracts/:id/comments` · `PATCH /contracts/:id/comments/:commentId` · `DELETE /contracts/:id/comments/:commentId` · TC-ACC-17
**Roles:** counsel-a, contracts-a, viewer-a, admin-b · **Needs:** nothing extra · **Time:** ~15 min

**Preconditions**
- `$C_MSA` (has clauses, so its tabs are reachable). Signed in as counsel-a.

**Steps**

| # | Do | Expect |
|---|----|--------|
| 1 | Open `$C_MSA`. The rail **Comments** reads "No comments yet.". Go to **Clauses → View all**, then the **Comments** tab. | Pills **Unresolved** (selected), **All**, **Resolved**. A card **Add a comment** with "Clause / Section (optional, e.g. Section 5.2)", "Write your comment…" and **Post comment** (disabled until there is text). Below, **No comments yet**. |
| 2 | Section `5.2`, text `Please confirm the liability cap with Finance.` → **Post comment**. Post a second comment `General: check the notice address.` with no section. | Each appears at once: a round initial, the author shown as the first 8 characters of your user id (see findings), a chip "5.2" on the first, "just now", and the text. On the right: a tick (tooltip "Mark resolved"), a bin ("Delete") and a reply arrow ("Reply"). |
| 3 | On the first comment click the reply arrow, type `Finance says the cap is the annual fee.` → **Post**. | A box "Write a reply…" with **Post**. The reply appears indented under the comment, and a chevron on the thread collapses and expands the replies. |
| 4 | Reload the page and open the rail **Comments** section. | Expected "2 comments." Bug today: it reads "9+ comments." whatever the count (see findings). **Open the thread** opens the Comments tab. |
| 5 | Click the tick on the second comment. | It leaves the **Unresolved** list. **Activity** gains "COMMENT RESOLVED". |
| 6 | Click **Resolved**, then **All**. | Expected: the resolved comment, then all of them. Bug today: **Resolved** shows "No comments yet" and **All** only the unresolved ones; the list isn't re-read when you switch (see findings). By API: `curl -s "$API/contracts/$C_MSA/comments?resolved=true" -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" \| jq '.data[].body'` returns the resolved one. |
| 7 | Edit by API (there is no edit button): `CM=$(curl -s "$API/contracts/$C_MSA/comments?clauseRef=5.2" -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" \| jq -r '.data[0].id'); curl -s -X PATCH $API/contracts/$C_MSA/comments/$CM -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"body":"Please confirm the liability cap with Finance by Friday."}' \| jq .body` Reload the tab. | The new text. `?clauseRef=5.2` finds the thread anchored to "5.2" (and to "5.2 <heading>"). `PATCH {"resolved":false}` reopens a resolved one. |
| 8 | Click the bin on the first comment. | The thread disappears, with its reply. No confirmation is asked. |
| 9 | `curl -s "$API/contracts/$C_MSA/comments?limit=1" -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" \| jq '{n:(.data\|length),nextCursor}'` | Top-level threads only, each with its `replies`; `nextCursor` is set when the page is full. |

**Also check**
- Authorship. contracts-a clicks the bin on counsel-a's comment: nothing happens and nothing says why (the API answers `404` `{"error":"Comment not found or not owned by you"}`). Yet contracts-a can change counsel-a's comment text with `PATCH` (`200`): editing checks no author (see findings).
- `POST` with `"body":""` → `400` `{"error":"body is required"}`. A `parentId` from another contract → `400` `{"error":"Parent comment not found"}` (TC-ACC-17).
- viewer-a sees the panel and **Post comment**, but posting, resolving and deleting do nothing and say nothing. By API `403` "Missing permission: edit:contract". rep-a (no `edit:contract`) likewise, even on rep-a's own contracts.
- admin-b: `GET $API/contracts/$C_MSA/comments` → `404` `{"error":"Contract not found"}`.
- Audit: `COMMENT_ADDED` (with `commentId` and `clauseRef`) and `COMMENT_RESOLVED` on the contract. Edits and deletions are not recorded. The Assistant can add comments (E2E-DOC-15); external reviewers' comments show as "External reviewer" (§4).

**Known limits**
- No edit or reopen control in the web app; use `PATCH`.
- Deleting a comment also hides its replies.
- Authors show as id prefixes, not names.

### E2E-DOC-11 · Attachments are added, downloaded and removed

**Covers:** /contracts/:id · `POST /contracts/:id/attach` · `GET /contracts/:id/attachments/:index/download` · `DELETE /contracts/:id/attachments/:index` · TC-ACC-04, TC-ACC-06
**Roles:** counsel-a, contracts-a, viewer-a, rep-a, admin-b · **Needs:** nothing extra · **Time:** ~10 min

**Preconditions**
- `$C_MSA`. `D-INVOICE.pdf`, `qa-fake.pdf`, `qa-empty.pdf`, `qa-services.txt`, and a schedule: `printf 'item,price\nseat,100\n' > qa-schedule.csv`.
- Signed in as counsel-a on `$C_MSA` → rail **Clauses → View all** → tab **Overview**.

**Steps**

| # | Do | Expect |
|---|----|--------|
| 1 | Find the card **Attachments**. | "(exhibits, schedules)" beside the heading, a link **+ Attach** on the right, and "No attachments. Click "+ Attach" to add exhibits, schedules, or reference documents.". |
| 2 | **+ Attach** → `D-INVOICE.pdf`. Then open the rail **History**. | The link reads "Uploading…", then a row appears: a paperclip, "D-INVOICE" (the file name without its extension) and the size ("N KB"). **History** lists "D-INVOICE" with the word "Attachment" under it. |
| 3 | **+ Attach** → `qa-schedule.csv`. | A second row, "qa-schedule", "0 KB" (sizes are rounded to whole KB). |
| 4 | Hover the first row and click the download icon (tooltip "Download"). | A new tab opens and the browser saves `D-INVOICE.pdf` under its original name. The link is valid for 5 minutes. |
| 5 | **+ Attach** → `qa-fake.pdf`. | A toast **Attachment not added**: "This file type is not accepted here. Allowed: PDF, DOCX, DOC, XLSX, TXT, CSV." No row is added. |
| 6 | Hover "qa-schedule" and click the bin (tooltip "Remove"). | The row disappears at once. No confirmation is asked. |
| 7 | `cget $C_MSA \| jq .attachments`; then `curl -s $API/contracts/$C_MSA/attachments/0/download -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" \| jq`; then `curl -s -o x.pdf "<the url>"`. | `[{"filename":"D-INVOICE.pdf","s3Key":…,"mimeType":"application/pdf","size":…,"label":"D-INVOICE"}]`, then `{"url":…,"filename":"D-INVOICE.pdf"}`. `x.pdf` is the invoice. |
| 8 | Attach with a label by API: `curl -s -X POST $API/contracts/$C_MSA/attach -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" -F "file=@qa-services.txt" -F "label=QA services annex" \| jq '.attachments[-1].label'`. Then send the same request with only `-F "label=x"` (no file), and once with `-F "file=@qa-empty.pdf"`. Then `DELETE $API/contracts/$C_MSA/attachments/9` and `GET …/attachments/9/download`. | `"QA services annex"`; the card shows it after a reload. Without a label the API uses the whole file name. No file: `400` "No file uploaded". Empty file: `400` "The uploaded file is empty.". Index 9: `400` `{"detail":"Attachment index out of range"}`, then `404` `{"detail":"Attachment not found"}`. |
| 9 | Tab **Activity**. Then `curl -s $API/contracts/$C_MSA/timeline -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" \| jq '[.data[] \| select(.metadata.action=="attach") \| .metadata]'` | One "CONTRACT UPDATED" per attach (three). The tab shows no details. The API gives `{"action":"attach","filename":…,"mimeType":…,"size":…}` for each. The removal in step 6 wrote nothing (see findings). |

**Also check**
- contracts-a and procurement-a (no `delete:contract`) can attach, but the bin does nothing and says nothing. By API: `403` "Missing permission: delete:contract".
- viewer-a: **+ Attach** → the toast **Attachment not added**, "You don't have permission to edit contracts.". The bin does nothing. rep-a gets the same toast, even on a contract rep-a owns (SALES_REP can't edit).
- admin-b: `curl -s $API/contracts/$C_MSA/attachments/0/download -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_B"` → `404` "Contract not found".
- Uploads are checked by their bytes and stored with the detected type. A download is served only as an allowed type (TC-ACC-04, TC-ACC-06).

**Known limits**
- Attachments are addressed by position. Removing one renumbers the rest, so a second tab with an older list can remove the wrong file.
- Attachments are stored, not analysed or searched. Only the Overview card manages them; the rail **History** lists them without actions.
- Remove asks for no confirmation and leaves no audit record (see findings).

Then **Clauses → View all → Overview** → the card **Contract Family**. | **History** lists the child under the label AMENDMENT. **Contract Family** lists it with "Amendment" on the right, and clicking an entry opens it. **+ Add related** is in the card's header. |
| 4 | **Actions → Create amendment** three more times: **Statement of Work** with Title `QA SOW 1`; **Order Form** with no title; **Exhibit** with no title. | Each opens a new Draft. All three have type OTHER: only an amendment takes the parent's type. The untitled ones are "<parent title> — order form" and "<parent title> — exhibit only". On the parent, **Contract Family** shows them as "Sow", "Order Form" and "Exhibit Only", and **History** as SOW, ORDER_FORM and EXHIBIT_ONLY. |
| 5 | `curl -s $API/contracts/$C_MSA/family -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" \| jq '{parent, children:[.children[]\|{title,relationshipType,status}], siblings}'`, then the same for `$C_AMD`. | `$C_MSA`: `parent` is null. `children` holds the four in the order made (`amendment`, `sow`, `order_form`, `exhibit_only`), each "DRAFT". `siblings` is []. `$C_AMD`: `parent` is `$C_MSA` as `{id,title,type,status,relationshipType}`, `children` is [], and `siblings` holds the other three. |
| 6 | Make one by API with every field: `C_REN=$(curl -s -X POST $API/contracts/$C_MSA/amendments -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "{\"relationshipType\":\"renewal\",\"title\":\"QA Renewal 2027\",\"effectiveDate\":\"$(day +100)\",\"expiryDate\":\"$(day +465)\",\"value\":60000,\"currency\":\"EUR\",\"description\":\"Renews the services for 2027.\"}" \| jq -r .id); cget $C_REN \| jq '{title,type,status,value,currency,expiryDate,relationshipType,metadata}'` | The create answers `201` `{id,title,type,status,parentContractId,relationshipType}`. Then: "QA Renewal 2027", "OTHER", "DRAFT", 60000, "EUR", the new expiry, "renewal", and `metadata` `{"amendmentDescription":"Renews the services for 2027."}`. Opened, the page shows "EUR 60,000". |
| 7 | On `$C_MSA` → Overview → **Contract Family** → **+ Add related**. Add `D-AMEND.pdf` and set its Title to `QA Amendment No. 1`. Leave the relationship as it is and click **Upload contract**. | The **Upload Contracts** dialog opens. Once the file is added, "Link to existing contract" already shows the chip "Contract <first 8 characters of $C_MSA's id>…". The relationship select shows **Amendment**; its choices are Amendment, Statement of Work (SOW), Order Form, Renewal, NDA, and Exhibit / Schedule. After the upload the dialog closes, and **Contract Family** lists the new contract with "Amendment". It is analysed like any upload, and the analysis may retitle it after the document. |
| 8 | Contracts → **Upload PDF** → add any file. In "Link to existing contract" (placeholder "Search by contract title…"), type the first letters of `$C_MSA`'s title. | Up to 8 matching contracts appear, each with its type. Picking one fills the chip and sets **Amendment**. Expected: the chip shows the picked contract's title. Bug today: it shows "Contract <id prefix>…" (see findings). The × beside the chip unlinks it. Close with **Cancel**. |

**Also check**
- `POST /contracts/$C_MSA/amendments` with `{"relationshipType":"nda"}` → `400` "relationshipType must be one of amendment, sow, order_form, renewal, exhibit_only". An unknown parent id → `404` "Parent contract not found". The body's `type` is stored unchecked: `{"type":"FOO"}` saves the type "FOO" (see findings).
- A parent in a matter passes the matter to its amendments (open the child: rail **Matter**). An amendment to a diligence-room document stays in that room (§6).
- rep-a can create amendments on contracts rep-a owns, and they belong to rep-a. On counsel-a's contract: `404` "Contract not found". viewer-a sees neither **Create amendment** nor **+ Add related**. By API: `403` "Missing permission: create:contract". admin-b → `404`.
- An upload's parent must be a live contract the caller can open: `curl -s -X POST $API/contracts/upload -H "Authorization: Bearer $REP_A" -F "file=@qa-services.txt" -F "title=x" -F "parentContractId=$C_MSA"` → `404` "Parent contract not found" (TC-ACC-19). The family view hides deleted and other-org relatives (E2E-DOC-14, step 6).
- Audit: `CONTRACT_CREATED` on the child, with `{"relationshipType":…,"parentContractId":…,"source":"amendment_flow"}`. It also fires the webhook `amendment.created` (§8). The Assistant reads the family (E2E-DOC-15, step 13).

**Known limits**
- The parent's own **Activity** doesn't record a new child.
- The upload dialog offers the relationship NDA, which the amendment route refuses. The rail **History** prints raw relationship names (SOW, ORDER_FORM, EXHIBIT_ONLY).
- An amendment's own page usually has no tab bar (no clauses, one version, no comments), so its **Contract Family** card is out of reach. Use the rail **History** instead.

### E2E-DOC-13 · An approver sees precedents: signed peers of the same type, and how this contract's risk compares

**Covers:** /contracts/:id · `GET /contracts/:id/precedents` · `PATCH /contracts/:id` · TC-WF-18
**Roles:** admin-a, counsel-a, viewer-a, admin-b · **Needs:** agents service + model key, and an embedding key (`VOYAGE_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY` or `GOOGLE_API_KEY` in the API's environment) · **Time:** ~25 min

**Preconditions**
- The seeded default workflow **Standard approval** sends an MSA to Legal Counsel (counsel-a) for one review step. §5 tests approvals themselves.
- Helpers for this journey (named so they don't clash with §5's):

```bash
pr_submit()  { curl -s -X POST "$API/contracts/$1/submit-approval" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_A" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{}' | jq -r 'if .instanceId then "\(.instanceId) \(.steps[0].id) \(.steps[0].approverId)" else tostring end'; }
pr_approve() { curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' -X POST "$API/approvals/$1/decide" -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "{\"stepId\":\"$2\",\"decision\":\"APPROVED\",\"comment\":\"QA\"}"; }
pr_set()     { curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' -X PATCH "$API/contracts/$1" -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "$2"; }
```

**Steps**

| # | Do | Expect |
|---|----|--------|
| 1 | `C_PEER=$(up $COUNSEL_A D-MSA.pdf "QA Peer MSA"); C_SUBJ=$(up $COUNSEL_A D-MSA.pdf "QA Subject MSA"); wait_done $C_PEER; wait_done $C_SUBJ; cget $C_PEER \| jq -r .type; cget $C_SUBJ \| jq -r .type` Then wait another minute. | Both are done, and both are `MSA`. If not, `POST /contracts/<id>/retype` `{"contractType":"MSA"}` and wait again. The API log shows `[worker:documents] ✓ job done name=embed-contract` for each; step 7 proves the embeddings exist. |
| 2 | Fix the names and the risk scores, which the analysis set: `pr_set $C_PEER '{"title":"QA Peer MSA","riskScore":50}'; pr_set $C_SUBJ '{"title":"QA Subject MSA","riskScore":52}'` | `HTTP 200` twice. |
| 3 | Approve the peer: `set -- $(pr_submit $C_PEER); echo "approver $3, counsel-a is $COUNSEL_A_ID"; pr_approve $1 $2; cget $C_PEER \| jq -r .status` | The approver is counsel-a. `HTTP 200`, then `APPROVED`. |
| 4 | Send the subject for approval: `set -- $(pr_submit $C_SUBJ); SUBJ_INST=$1; SUBJ_STEP=$2` | A pending Legal review step for counsel-a. |
| 5 | As admin-a, open "QA Subject MSA". | No **Precedents** section in the rail: only the pending approver gets it. |
| 6 | As counsel-a, open "QA Subject MSA". | The approver's decision strip (§5), and the rail section **Precedents**, open, with the count 1. First a chip "In line with peer avg" (tooltip "Compared to signed peers of the same contract type"). Then one peer: an indigo chip "100%" (the similarity; the texts are identical), the title "QA Peer MSA" (a link to it), and "<counterparty> · <Mon YYYY> · Risk 50". |
| 7 | `curl -s $API/contracts/$C_SUBJ/precedents -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" \| jq` | `data` holds one peer: `{"contractId":"<$C_PEER>","title":"QA Peer MSA","type":"MSA","value":…,"counterparty":…,"signedAt":…,"riskScore":50,"similarity":0.99…}`. Then `"selfRiskScore":52`, `"peerAvgRiskScore":50` and `"riskDeltaLabel":"In line with peer avg"`. |
| 8 | `pr_set $C_SUBJ '{"riskScore":80}'` and reload; then `pr_set $C_SUBJ '{"riskScore":20}'` and reload. | A red chip "60% higher risk than peer avg", then a green chip "60% lower risk than peer avg". The label compares the difference with the peers' average; under 10 % it reads "In line with peer avg". |
| 9 | Open "QA Peer MSA" (**Approved**) and click **Mark as Executed**. Reload the subject. | The peer is **Executed**, and **Archive** is offered. The subject still lists it: approved and executed contracts both count. |
| 10 | On the peer, click **Archive**. Reload the subject. | The peer is **Archived**. The subject's section reads "No signed precedents of this type yet in your workspace." and shows no chip. The API returns `"data":[]` and `"peerAvgRiskScore":null`. |
| 11 | `curl -s $API/contracts/$C_BLANK/precedents -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" \| jq '{data,message}'` (a contract with no clauses). | `{"data":[],"message":"No embeddings yet for this contract — precedents unavailable"}`. An approver would see only the "No signed precedents…" text in the rail. |
| 12 | Clean up: `pr_approve $SUBJ_INST $SUBJ_STEP` | `HTTP 200`. The subject is **Approved** and leaves counsel-a's queue. |

**Also check**
- viewer-a can read `GET /contracts/$C_SUBJ/precedents` (`200`), but never sees the section. admin-b → `404` "Contract not found".
- At own scope (rep-a), peers come only from contracts rep-a owns. Precedents compare each contract's current version, and never offer a diligence-room contract as a peer (TC-WF-18).

**Known limits**
- Only the three closest peers are shown, and only to the pending approver.
- The date beside a peer is its last update, not its signature date (see findings).
- Without an embedding key no contract has embeddings, so every contract gets step 11's answer.

### E2E-DOC-14 · A contract is deleted, and every contract route refuses the wrong role, owner and org

**Covers:** /contracts · /contracts/:id · `DELETE /contracts/:id` · `GET /contracts/:id` · `GET /contracts/:id/family` · TC-ACC-07, TC-ACC-12
**Roles:** counsel-a, contracts-a, rep-a, viewer-a, admin-a, admin-b · **Needs:** nothing extra · **Time:** ~10 min

**Preconditions**
- `$C_BLANK` (E2E-DOC-08) and `$C_MSA`. rep-a owns `$C_CONV` (E2E-REQ-03). Signed in as counsel-a.

**Steps**

| # | Do | Expect |
|---|----|--------|
| 1 | `for t in "$CONTRACTS_A" "$VIEWER_A" "$REP_A"; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} ' -X DELETE $API/contracts/$C_BLANK -H "Authorization: Bearer $t"; done; echo` | `403 403 403`. Each body has `detail` "Missing permission: delete:contract". |
| 2 | `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -X DELETE $API/contracts/$C_BLANK -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A"` | `204`. The web app has no delete button. |
| 3 | Reload Contracts and search `QA Blank`. Open `$WEB/contracts/$C_BLANK`. | The row is gone, and the count is one lower. The search finds nothing, because the index entry was removed. The page shows "Contract not found" and **Back to Contracts**. |
| 4 | `for p in "" /versions /timeline /download /comments; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} $p\n" "$API/contracts/$C_BLANK$p" -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A"; done`. Then `DELETE` it again. | `404` for each. The body is `"detail":"Contract not found"`, except the comments route, which says `"error":"Contract not found"`. The second `DELETE` → `404`. |
| 5 | As admin-a: Admin → **Organization** → **Audit Log**, Action `CONTRACT_DELETED`, **Filter**. | A row `CONTRACT_DELETED` · `contract · <$C_BLANK>`, actor Legal Counsel. |
| 6 | Delete a parent: `P=$(curl -s -X POST $API/contracts -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"QA parent to delete","type":"MSA"}' \| jq -r .id); A=$(curl -s -X POST $API/contracts/$P/amendments -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{}' \| jq -r .id); curl -s -X DELETE $API/contracts/$P -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A"; curl -s $API/contracts/$A/family -H "Authorization: Bearer $COUNSEL_A" \| jq .parent` | `null`. The amendment stays, and its page shows no **Parent** in **History** (TC-ACC-19). |
| 7 | Another org reads nothing: `for p in "" /versions /clauses /timeline /family /precedents /comments /download /attachments/0/download; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} GET $p\n" "$API/contracts/$C_MSA$p" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_B"; done` | `404` for every one. Signed in as admin-b, `$WEB/contracts/$C_MSA` shows "Contract not found". |
| 8 | …and changes nothing: `w() { m=$1; p=$2; shift 2; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} $m $p\n" -X "$m" "$API/contracts/$C_MSA$p" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_B" "$@"; }`, then `w PATCH "" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"x"}'`, `w POST /analyze`, `w POST /retype -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"contractType":"NDA"}'`, `w POST /cancel-analysis`, `w POST /split -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"splits":[{"pageStart":1,"pageEnd":1},{"pageStart":2,"pageEnd":2}]}'`, `w POST /amendments -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{}'`, `w POST /comments -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"body":"x"}'`, `w POST /html-version -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"htmlContent":"<p>x</p>"}'`, `w POST /attach -F "file=@qa-services.txt"`, `w POST /versions -F "file=@qa-services.txt"`, `w DELETE ""` | `404` every time, and `$C_MSA` is unchanged for counsel-a. |
| 9 | Own scope: run step 7's loop with `$REP_A` in place of `$ADMIN_B`. Then `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' $API/contracts/$C_CONV -H "Authorization: Bearer $REP_A"` | `404` "Contract not found" for everything on `$C_MSA`, which rep-a doesn't own, and `200` for rep-a's own `$C_CONV` (TC-ACC-07). The Assistant's tools apply the same scope (TC-ACC-12, E2E-DOC-15). |

**Known limits**
- Deletion is a soft delete. There is no restore, in the web app or the API, and no delete button.

### E2E-DOC-15 · The Assistant reads, checks and updates a contract, lists custom fields and adds comments, writing only after Apply

**Covers:** /contracts/:id · contract_get · contract_summarize · contract_validate · custom_field_list · contract_update · comment_add · TC-ACC-12, TC-ACC-14, TC-ACC-16, TC-FAMILY-01, TC-FAMILY-02
**Roles:** counsel-a, rep-a, viewer-a · **Needs:** agents service + model key · **Time:** ~25 min

**Preconditions**
- `$C_TXT` (Draft, analysed). Its text still has "Section ___", and both "Customer" and "customer". The global custom field "Data region (QA)" from E2E-DOC-06. `$C_MSA` with its amendments from E2E-DOC-12.
- Signed in as counsel-a on `$C_TXT`'s page, with the Ask panel open. Keep a second browser tab on `$WEB/contracts/$C_TXT` to watch the changes. The panel's own page doesn't refresh after **Apply**, and reloading it drops the receipts and their **Undo**.
- The panel's first message fixes its contract: "this contract" means `$C_TXT` until you start a new thread (the panel's **New thread** icon).

**Steps**

| # | Do | Expect |
|---|----|--------|
| 1 | Send `Summarize this contract in three bullet points.` | A chip `contract_summarize`; its line shows the contract's title or id. The answer is three bullets on the parties, the fee and term, and the renewal notice, matching the Overview. No card appears: read tools change nothing. |
| 2 | Send `Read this contract in full and list every obligation Northwind has under it.` | A chip `contract_get`. Click it: **Args** has this contract's id, and **Result** has `plainText`, `keyTerms`, `family` and `"documentOnFile": true`. The answer lists what the Provider must do, from the text. If the model used `clause_search` or `contract_cite` instead, send `Use contract_get to read the whole text.` |
| 3 | Send `Is this contract ready to send? Check it for errors.` | A chip `contract_validate`, and no card. The answer names the unfilled placeholder "Section ___" as a serious problem, and "Customer" also written "customer" as a lesser one. The chip's **Result** has `issues` with `{"kind":"unresolved_crossref","severity":"high","message":"Placeholder reference \"Section ___\" was never filled in.",…}` and `{"kind":"defined_term_drift","severity":"medium",…}`. It also has `"definedTerms":["Customer","Provider"]` and `"structureAvailable":false`. |
| 4 | Send `What custom fields do we track on MSAs?` | A chip `custom_field_list` with `contract_type` "MSA". The answer lists "Data region (QA)": a required select with the options EU and US, which applies to all types. |
| 5 | Send `Tag this contract qa-reviewed.` | A card: **About to run** `contract_update`, the badge **Undoable**, "Add tag 'qa-reviewed' on this contract", "Target: Contract <first 12 characters of the id>…", and **Cancel**, **Edit** and **Apply**. Nothing has changed yet: `cget $C_TXT \| jq .tags` doesn't include it. |
| 6 | **Apply**. Check `cget $C_TXT \| jq .tags`. Then click **Undo** on the receipt and check again. | "Applying…", then "Applied · Add tag 'qa-reviewed' on this contract" with **Undo** (tooltip "Undo this action (within 15 minutes)"). The tags now include "qa-reviewed"; the second tab shows it under Overview → **Tags** after a reload. After **Undo**: "Undone · …", and the tag is gone. |
| 7 | Send `Set the status of this contract to PENDING_REVIEW.` → **Apply**, and reload the second tab. Then **Undo**, and reload it again. | The card reads "Set status to PENDING_REVIEW on this contract", with **Undoable**. After **Apply** the second tab's pill reads **In Review**; after **Undo**, **Draft**. The contract's **Activity** records neither change (see findings). |
| 8 | Send `Mark this contract as approved.` | The Assistant should say approval goes through **Send for Review** (§5). If it proposes a card anyway, **Apply** gives "Failed · Set status to APPROVED on this contract · APPROVED is set by the approval workflow, not by hand. Submit…". The receipt cuts the reason at 80 characters. The status doesn't change. |
| 9 | Send `Assign this contract to Casey Contracts.` → **Apply**, and reload the second tab. Then **Undo**. | A chip `user_search`, then a card "Assign owner to user <Casey's id> on this contract". After **Apply**, the owner chip in the header reads "Casey Contracts". **Undo** makes counsel-a the owner again. |
| 10 | Send `Add a comment on section 2: Finance to confirm the invoicing schedule.` → **Apply**. In the second tab, reload and open rail **Comments → Open the thread**. Then **Undo**, and reload. | A card `comment_add`, **Undoable**: 'Add a comment anchored to §2: "Finance to confirm the invoicing schedule."'. After **Apply** the comment is in the **Comments** tab with the chip "2", authored by you (shown as your id prefix). After **Undo** it is gone. |
| 11 | Send `Tag this contract temp.` and click **Cancel** on the card. | "Cancelled · Add tag 'temp' on this contract". Nothing changes. |
| 12 | Send `This is actually a statement of work — change its type.` → **Apply**. | The card has no **Undoable** badge. It reads "Re-type contract as SOW and re-run extraction on this contract". After **Apply** the receipt has no **Undo**. The contract re-analyses: its Contracts row shows **Classifying**, then the later stages. **Activity** gains "CONTRACT UPDATED" (`metadata.source` "agent"). Expected: the type ends as SOW. Bug today: the re-analysis runs the classifier again, and the classifier sets its own type, e.g. MSA (see findings). The type chip on the page (E2E-DOC-05) keeps the type you choose. |
| 13 | Open `$C_MSA` and click **New thread** in the panel. Send `How much notice do we need to give to stop this agreement from renewing?` | A chip `contract_summarize` or `contract_get`. Its **Result** has `family.children`, the amendments each with their `text`, and a `familyNote` that begins "A later contract changes this one's terms". The answer is ninety (90) days, and it names the amendment that changed it. It does not give the MSA's own sixty (60) days (TC-FAMILY-01, TC-FAMILY-02). |

**Also check**
- viewer-a asks for steps 5 and 10 and clicks **Apply** → "Failed · … · Missing permission: edit:contract" (TC-ACC-14). The read tools in steps 1–4 work for viewer-a.
- rep-a's read tools answer only about contracts rep-a owns. Asked about another one (paste its id), they say it isn't found (TC-ACC-12). rep-a's write cards fail on **Apply** with "Missing permission: edit:contract", even on rep-a's own contracts, because SALES_REP can't edit. An own-scope role that can edit reaches only the contracts it owns, on Apply and on Undo (TC-ACC-16).
- Audit (Admin → Organization → **Audit Log**): each **Apply** is `AGENT_TOOL_APPLIED` on `agent_tool_call · <id>`, with the tool name, the arguments and the status. A failed **Apply** is recorded too. Each **Undo** is `AGENT_TOOL_UNDONE`.

**Known limits**
- The page behind the panel doesn't refresh after **Apply** or **Undo**. **Undo** exists only on the receipt: after a reload the conversation can be reopened from the thread list, but without its receipts (see findings).
- **Undo** lasts 15 minutes, and only tags, status, owner and comments have it. A retype or a re-analysis can't be undone.
- Status, owner, tag and comment changes made by the Assistant appear in the audit log as tool calls, not on the contract's **Activity**.
## 3. Templates, the clause library and drafting

This section tests the drafting library and everything that drafts from it: the Templates page (`/templates`) with its
builder, preview, Word upload and delete; the clause library (`/clauses`) with its categories and approvals, and using a
clause in a template; industry packs (Settings → **Industry packs** and the admin packs API); and drafting a contract from
a template, from Contracts → **Draft new** and from the Assistant, on the full `/agent` page and in the side panel. Run it
in order: TPL-01 to TPL-09 (they make the fixtures later journeys use), then CLS-01 to CLS-05, PACK-01 and PACK-02, and
DRAFT-01 to DRAFT-06. Journeys marked "agents service + model key" call a model: their wording varies from run to run,
so check structure, fixed labels and what was created, not the model's exact sentences. The API steps marked "no model"
give the same answer every time.

### Before you start (section 3)

**Starting state of Org A** after `pnpm dev:setup` (record your own numbers first if other sections already ran, and
read the expectations below as differences):

| What | Fresh value |
|------|-------------|
| Templates | 20, of which 19 published. "Mutual Idea Submission Agreement" is the unpublished one |
| Clause categories | 18, all top level, "Definitions & Interpretation" first |
| Clauses | 106; 3 not approved ("Confidentiality Term — 3 Years", "No Termination for Convenience (Vendor-Favorable)", "Self-Insurance (Vendor Pushback)"); 8 rated unfavorable |
| Playbook positions | 62 |
| Industry packs installed | none |
| Built-in skills | 9, including "Draft from template" and "Draft from scratch" |

**Who can do what here** (from `apps/api/src/lib/permissions.ts`; "own" = only their own contracts):

| Capability | admin-a | counsel-a | legalops-a | contracts-a | rep-a | procurement-a | finance-a | approver-a | viewer-a |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| See templates, preview, generate | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | – | – | ✓ |
| Create templates (incl. Upload .docx) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | – | – | – | – | – | – |
| Edit, publish, unpublish templates | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | – | – | – | – | – |
| Delete templates | ✓ | – | ✓ | – | – | – | – | – | – |
| See clauses and categories | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | – | – | ✓ |
| Create clauses and categories | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | – | – | – | – | – | – |
| Edit and approve clauses, edit categories | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | – | – | – | – | – | – |
| Delete clauses and categories | ✓ | – | ✓ | – | – | – | – | – | – |
| Install a pack from Settings | ✓ | – | ✓ | – | – | – | – | – | – |
| `/admin/packs` API | ✓ | – | – | – | – | – | – | – | – |
| Draft a contract (Draft new, Assistant Apply) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | own | ✓ | – | – | – |

A refused API call answers 403 `{"detail":"Missing permission: <action>:<resource>"}`. The Templates and Clauses pages
show their buttons to every role: when a role can't do something, the browser refuses the request and **nothing visible
happens** (reported as a defect; see TPL-09 and CLS-05).

**Helpers for this section** (bash or zsh; they use §0's `$API`, tokens, `$ORG_A`, `$ORG_B` and `$INTERNAL_SECRET`):

```bash
uid()  { curl -s "$API/users/me" -H "Authorization: Bearer $1" | jq -r .id; }
export COUNSEL_A_ID=$(uid $COUNSEL_A) FINANCE_A_ID=$(uid $FINANCE_A) ADMIN_B_ID=$(uid $ADMIN_B)
code() { curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$@"; }                       # HTTP status only
tid()  { curl -s "$API/templates?limit=200" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_A" \
           | jq -r --arg n "$1" '[.data[] | select(.name==$n)][0].id'; }      # Org A template id by exact name
# An internal tool call, as the agents service makes it (prints the JSON body). No model involved.
tj()   { curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:3001/api/internal/ai/tools/$1" -H "x-internal-secret: $INTERNAL_SECRET" \
           -H "x-internal-service: agents" -H "content-type: application/json" -d "$2"; }
tjs()  { code -X POST "http://localhost:3001/api/internal/ai/tools/$1" -H "x-internal-secret: $INTERNAL_SECRET" \
           -H "x-internal-service: agents" -H "content-type: application/json" -d "$2"; echo; }
# The call behind the Assistant's Apply for a draft: makes a thread for <token>, applies <args JSON>.
draftapply() {
  local t=$(curl -s -X POST "$API/agent/threads" -H "Authorization: Bearer $1" -H 'content-type: application/json' \
            -d '{"title":"QA API drafting"}' | jq -r .id)
  curl -s -w '\n' -X POST "$API/agent/threads/$t/actions/apply" -H "Authorization: Bearer $1" \
    -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "{\"toolName\":\"contract_create_from_template\",\"args\":$2}" \
    | jq -c --arg t "$t" '. + {threadId: $t}'
}
counts() { echo "templates $(curl -s "$API/templates?limit=1" -H "Authorization: Bearer $1" | jq .total)" \
  "clauses $(curl -s "$API/clauses?limit=1" -H "Authorization: Bearer $1" | jq .total)" \
  "positions $(curl -s "$API/playbook/positions" -H "Authorization: Bearer $1" | jq '.data | length')"; }
```

Signing a user in with curl signs that user's browser tab out at its next refresh (§0): use one user in the browser and
another in the shell when steps run at the same time, or sign in again afterwards.

**Fixtures made in this section** (names are used later; ids are exported in the step that makes them):
`$T_QA` "QA Services Agreement" (TPL-02), `$T_COND` "QA Conditional Terms" (TPL-06), "D TPL" and "D NDA" uploads
(TPL-07), "QA Category" / "QA Sub" (CLS-02), `$CL_REF` "QA Ref Clause" and `$T_REF` "QA Clause Ref" (CLS-04), `$T_NDA`
"QA Mutual NDA", `$T_OFFER` "QA Offer Letter" and the counterparty "Hooli" (DRAFT-03), `$T_SUPPLY` "QA Supply
Agreement" (DRAFT-05).

**Covers:** `/templates` · `GET /templates`, `GET /templates/:id` · docs/38: —
**Roles:** counsel-a, viewer-a, finance-a · **Needs:** nothing extra · **Time:** ~10 min

- Signed in as counsel-a. Command A's first line prints `{"total":20,"published":19}` on a fresh setup.

Hovering the three icons at the top right shows "Preview", "Edit", "Delete". |
